findings.detail: The source prints the Carestream spread as PRIME + 750, a basis-point spread that should be stored as 7.5 under the platform whole-number percentage convention, not 750.0.

citation.quoted_text: Carestream Health, Inc. (First Lien Term Loan) (7) | PRIME + 750 | 5.34 | % | 9/30/2027 | 655,663 | 586,706 | 587,366

rationale: Class 1 single-cell check. The flagged value is basis_spread=750.0 for the Carestream Health row. Raw source table 17 row 8 shows the loan terms as PRIME + 750. Under the platform convention stated in the C115 evidence, spreads are stored as whole-number percentages, so the 750 basis-point token should normalize to 7.5. The stored value remains in basis points and is therefore a real rate-scale data error.
